Is your dissertation topic too broad? Check these 5 signs 👇

1. You can't explain it in one sentence
2. Your search returns thousands of sources
3. It covers many countries or industries at once
4. You can't collect the data before your deadline
5. Your question has no clear group or setting

If 2 or more sound familiar, narrow it down: one sector, one country, one clear question.

Losing easy marks on referencing? Get these 3 Harvard rules right ✍️

1️⃣ In-text: (Author, Year), e.g. (Smith, 2024)
2️⃣ Direct quote: add the page, e.g. (Smith, 2024, p. 12)
3️⃣ Reference list: A to Z by surname, with every source you cited

Always check your university's own Harvard guide, as small details differ.
